src/integrations/mqtt/client.rs.description: TLS configuration for MQTT is implemented via configure_tls() helper function. Uses TlsConfiguration::default() which leverages system CA certificates via rustls-native-certs. Applied in both connect() and spawn_reconnection_task() to ensure TLS works for initial connections and reconnections.

src/integrations/mqtt/fan.rs.description: FanController is fully implemented with zone-based speed logic. DefaultFanController supports multiple fan profiles, auto/manual mode, change delay, and 4 payload formats (SpeedOnly, JsonSpeed, JsonSpeedOnOff, Percentage).

Cargo.toml.description: rumqttc = "0.24" and keyring = "2.0" are already in dependencies for MQTT and secure password storage.

src/integrations/mqtt/mod.rs.description: MqttCredentialStore implements secure MQTT password storage using the keyring crate. Passwords are stored in the OS keyring with key format "username@host" under service name "RustRide-MQTT". The DefaultMqttClient uses configure_credentials() helper to retrieve passwords during connect() and reconnection.
